core.fantasy: You are a group of civilians trying to survive a siege, one day of scavenging and one night of fear at a time.
pillars: Hard choices with no good answer
Day to build, night to risk
core.signature_moment: Hearing a noise ring bloom in a dark room you haven't entered yet.

signatures.description: Character needs are written as graded words on portraits, never bars.
Sound you make and hear is drawn as rings in the world where it happens.
The interface is drawn in the same pencil and charcoal hand as the world.

body.note: Survivor state as graded words (hungry, very tired, depressed) on portraits and bios; bodies slump and move slower.

time.note: Clock and day count; a charcoal title card each morning; night falls in the cutaway.

threat.note: Noise rings around you and from unseen rooms; unexplored rooms are dark and hatched.

thing_state.note: Interaction icons over beds, stoves, rubble and doors.

goals.note: Survive until the ceasefire; the radio carries news of prices and fighting.

tools.note: Inventory and crafting panels drawn as pencil sketches.

social.note: Moods and relationships as words on portraits plus short spoken lines.

hud_coverage.method: HUD study (docs/oracle/hud/HUD_STUDY.md), public guides and prior knowledge; not yet measured on capture

always_on_count.method: HUD study (docs/oracle/hud/HUD_STUDY.md), public guides and prior knowledge; not yet measured on capture

screen_budget.fade_rule: Interaction icons appear only near usable objects.

signals.note: Night switches to the scavenging map, darkness and quieter, tenser music.

max_channels.method: HUD study (docs/oracle/hud/HUD_STUDY.md), public guides and prior knowledge; not yet measured on capture

adapts_score.method: HUD study (docs/oracle/hud/HUD_STUDY.md), public guides and prior knowledge; not yet measured on capture

social_channel.note: People, not numbers: states are written as words.

dialects.note: Danger shown where it is: rings and darkness.

style: state as plain words or bodies rather than bars
noise as rings in the world
UI drawn in the world's own hand
expression: the charcoal art and sketch frames

take.setting: A thirsty cow shows it on the cow (body and bubble), never on a bar.
